query: UPDATE draft SET value = to_json(jsonb_set(to_jsonb(value), ARRAY['on_behalf_of_email'], to_jsonb($1::text))) WHERE typ IN ('script', 'flow') AND value->>'on_behalf_of_email' = $2 AND NOT (value->>'on_behalf_of_permissioned_as' LIKE 'g/%' AND value->>'on_behalf_of_permissioned_as' NOT LIKE '%@%')
